hikes.name: Mount St Helens via Monitor Ridge
hikes.blurb: Boulders and ash to the crater rim of the 1980 eruption, looking down at the lava dome steaming inside (climbing permit).

hikes.name: Lewis River Falls
hikes.blurb: Along a broad river past three wide, terraced falls, each different.

hikes.name: Lava Canyon
hikes.blurb: A canyon scoured to bare rock by the 1980 mudflow, crossed by a swaying suspension bridge.

hikes.name: June Lake
hikes.blurb: An easy climb to a small lake with a waterfall pouring in beside a lava flow.

hikes.name: Norway Pass
hikes.blurb: Through the blown-down forest to a pass looking over Spirit Lake's log raft into the open crater.

hikes.name: Mount Margaret
hikes.blurb: Past Norway Pass to the high point of the Mount Margaret backcountry, Rainier, Adams and St Helens all around.

hikes.name: Siouxon Creek
hikes.blurb: A gentle walk up a clear, emerald creek past waterfall after waterfall.

hikes.name: Falls Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Over a suspension bridge to a three-tier falls more than 200 feet tall.

hikes.name: Lone Butte
hikes.blurb: From Cultus Creek Trailhead, a 13.8-mile round trip to the top of Lone Butte (5,239 ft), with about 3,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lemei Rock
hikes.blurb: From Indian Heaven Trailhead, a 7.4-mile round trip to the top of Lemei Rock (5,641 ft), with about 1,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Jumbo Peak
hikes.blurb: From Sunrise Trailhead, a 6.3-mile round trip to the top of Jumbo Peak (5,421 ft), with about 1,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Placid Lake
hikes.blurb: From Cultus Creek Trailhead, a 9.5-mile round trip to Placid Lake, with about 2,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Chenamus Lake
hikes.blurb: From Cultus Creek Trailhead, a 9.5-mile round trip to Chenamus Lake, with about 2,400 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Harmony Falls
hikes.blurb: From Harmony Falls Trailhead, a 2.3-mile round trip to Harmony Falls, with about 600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Whittier
hikes.blurb: From Norway Pass Trailhead, a 10.9-mile round trip to the top of Mount Whittier (5,874 ft), with about 2,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Wood Lake
hikes.blurb: From Cultus Creek Trailhead, a 4.6-mile round trip to Wood Lake, with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Deer Lake
hikes.blurb: From Indian Heaven Trailhead, a 6.3-mile round trip to Deer Lake, with about 1,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lemei Lake
hikes.blurb: From Indian Heaven Trailhead, a 6.8-mile round trip to Lemei Lake, with about 1,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Deep Lake
hikes.blurb: From Indian Heaven Trailhead, a 5.0-mile round trip to Deep Lake, with about 1,250 feet of climbing.
